Name: I can't get no sleep
Author: BrochersModsProductions
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Stay awake past 2 AM and keep playing until 6 AM! ICGNS starts a new day and saves your progress at dawn.
[b][u]Shipping bin items are sold when you sleep or pass out from exhaustion.[/u][/b] [u]If you stay awake all night, your items remain in the bin until your next sleep or exhaustion pass-out.[/u]
[heading]Download Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download [b]I Can't Get No Sleep[/b] from the [b]Files[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]I Can't Get No Sleep [/b]folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]To update, close the game and replace the existing mod files.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Removes the automatic 2 AM pass-out.[/*]
[*]Starts a new day at 6 AM with the usual daily updates and saving.[/*]
[*]Keeps unsold items through consecutive all-nighters and save reloads.[/*]
[*]Includes mini shipping bins.[/*]
[*]Preserves your current energy and health after an all-nighter.[/*]
[*]Includes multiplayer rules for shared and separate wallets.[/*]
[/list]With shared money, shipping requires every online player to sleep or pass out. With separate wallets, each player’s sales depend on their own sleep.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] on [b]64-bit Windows[/b].[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]For multiplayer, the same mod version must be installed by the host and every player.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/superbroche-s-organisation/I-Can-t-Get-No-Sleep/tree/main][b]Public GitHub and Issue Tracker[/b][/url]
